paragraphs.text: He declares how the faithful will always have opportunity to praise God, as in their need they will feel his power at hand to help them.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: When I see my time (says God) to help your miseries, I will come and set all things in good order.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: When I shall receive the congregation

paragraphs.text: Though all things are brought to ruin, yet I can restore and preserve them.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: The prophet warns the wicked that they would not set themselves against God's people, seeing that God at his time destroys them who rule wickedly.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: God's wrath is compared to a cup of strong and delicate wine, with which the wicked are made so drunk that by drinking till they come to the very dregs they are utterly destroyed.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: The godly will better prosper by their innocent simplicity, than the wicked will by all their craft and subtilty.
paragraphs.label: g
